description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Kami of Whispered Hopes
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater
